# Wisp

Type: Material | Internal ID: Wisp | Source: Wisp fountain | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Wisps are collected around Wisp fountains at night. They are used primarily to craft the Wisplight as well as some items and Furniture.

### Building

• Wisp torch

### Crafting

• Wisplight
• Mistwalker
